title: MI60022: Fundamentals And Applications Of Gps Technologies
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

GPS Fundamentals, GPS in Mapping: Geodesy, Datum, map projections. Aspects of
GPS Functioning, GPS in Surveying: Coordinate systems, GPS positioning modes,
Static GPS surveying, real time GPS surveying, real time differential GPS, GPS
Errors and Biases: Delays, satellite geometry measures, concept of DOP, PDOP,
Canopy effect. Ambiguity Resolution, GPS Physics and Data Formats: Data
quality, standards and documentation. A brief about GPS sensors and the Physics
of GPS functional units. GPS-GIS Integration, GPS Applications
